ads_enabled.description: Master switch. false disables every ad type in the app (app open, interstitial, banner, native).

app_open_ads_enabled.description: App Open ads on/off. Also requires ads_enabled.

interstitial_ads_enabled.description: Interstitial ads on/off. Also requires ads_enabled.

banner_ads_enabled.description: Banner ads on/off (home banner, chat, contacts, after-call). Also requires ads_enabled.

native_ads_enabled.description: Native ads on/off, including the ad row that sits as the 2nd item of every list. Also requires ads_enabled.

recent_app_open_ads_id.description: App Open ad unit shown when the app returns to the foreground. TEST ID - replace before release.

splash_app_open_ads_id.description: App Open ad unit shown on the splash screen. TEST ID - replace before release.

interstitial_feature_ads_id.description: Interstitial shown on main feature clicks (Backup, Scheduled, Blocking, Private Chat, Themes, AI Chat, Settings, Compose). TEST ID - replace before release.

banner_ads_id.description: Adaptive banner unit. TEST ID - replace before release.

native_list_ads_id.description: Native ad rendered as the 2nd item of every list. TEST ID - replace before release.

native_big_ads_id.description: Native ad in the tall media format (language screen and similar). TEST ID (native video) - replace before release.

interstitial_first_clicks.description: Feature clicks needed before the 1st interstitial of the session. Must be > 0; 0 or missing falls back to the in-app default of 3.

interstitial_second_clicks.description: Further feature clicks needed after the 1st interstitial before the 2nd one. Falls back to 4.

interstitial_second_delay_seconds.description: Seconds that must pass after the 1st interstitial before the 2nd one may show. Falls back to 60.

interstitial_max_count.description: Maximum interstitials per app session. Falls back to 2.

privacy_policy_url.description: Privacy policy opened from the paywall. Replace with the real URL.

terms_of_service_url.description: Terms of service URL. Replace with the real URL.

support_email.description: Address the support row composes a mail to.
